status: Licences read from the Commons API (extmetadata) and the file pages' wikitext on 2026-11-19; raw answers in _commons.json and _wikitext.json. All files are US public domain per Commons tags; outside the US the status of 1945 press photos is not confirmed.

assets.author: International News Photos
assets.what_it_shows: The Empire State Building tower in smoke the morning of the crash, 28 July 1945 (published in the Pittsburgh Sun-Telegraph). No people, no injury.
assets.note: Commons source: Pittsburgh Sun-Telegraph newspage 524041830; Getty also sells a copy (514953014). Basis is US no-renewal of a 1945 newspaper publication; not independently checked against the 1972-73 renewal records.

assets.author: Acme Newspictures
assets.license: Public domain (US, published 1927-1977 without a copyright notice)
assets.license_tag: {{PD-Pre1978}}; Permission field: 'Pre-1978 no mark'; page note: 'A search for original registrations was done in artwork for the year 1945. There were no listings for Acme Newspictures; there's no evidence that this photo was ever copyrighted.' Front and back of the original print linked (hyeeauctions.com A18/1/67, 67a).
assets.what_it_shows: The hole the B-25 made in the north wall, wreckage hanging in it, 28 July 1945 (Commons says 78th floor).
kit_assets: ff_el_hole.jpg (558x691 original upscaled to 1000 wide, lanczos)
assets.note: Recheck asked for the US no-renewal basis: this file's tag is NOT a no-renewal tag. It is {{PD-Pre1978}} (no notice on the print), backed by a scan of the print's back and a 1945 registration search with no Acme listings. The no-renewal tag is on the INP tower photo (first frame).

assets.author: International News Photo
assets.what_it_shows: Inside one of the burning floors after the crash, wreckage on the floor, one man standing. INP caption: 'All elevators above the crash point were reported out of commission'.
assets.note: Source: worthpoint listing of the wire print.
